name: POST /api/voice/webhooks/telnyx/status - Telnyx signed call-status webhook
description: PUBLIC signed webhook (a0b36c83-48b0-4356-a5e7-6e253ac9e822#AC3 — Telnyx status webhooks are signature-verified and mirrored idempotently). Telnyx signs each webhook with Ed25519: telnyx-signature-ed25519 is the base64 signature over `${telnyx-timestamp}|${raw body}`, checked against TELNYX_PUBLIC_KEY; a timestamp more than TELNYX_WEBHOOK_TOLERANCE_S (300 s) away is refused as a replay, and a tampered body fails. Verification fails closed in production when the key is unset and is unenforced outside production. The gateway auth gate allowlists /api/voice/webhooks/. Events: call.initiated -> initiated, call.ringing -> ringing, call.answered / call.bridged -> in-progress, call.hangup -> completed when the leg was answered, else busy (user_busy) / no-answer (no_answer, timeout) / canceled (originator_cancel, normal_clearing) / failed; call.machine.detection.ended sets answered_by. Idempotent: every event id is recorded, so a redelivery returns duplicate=true and changes nothing; a status never moves backwards. The mirror row (connector_telnyx_voice.voice_call, keyed by call_leg_id) takes its tenant from the Telnyx connection id of the tenant's trunk, and the event is applied to the AI call whose carrier_call_sid is the call_leg_id (ai_call_id). Every recorded event is acknowledged with 200 so Telnyx stops retrying.

testCases.name: Answered event for an unknown leg (unsigned: key not configured in test)

errorCases.message: webhook body must carry data.id and data.event_type
errorCases.when: the body is not JSON or lacks data.id / data.event_type
signature missing or wrong, timestamp outside the tolerance window, body altered, or (production) TELNYX_PUBLIC_KEY not configured
